## Problem and change

Describe the observable problem and the behavior after this change.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results. For a bug, include the reproduction or regression test.

## Compatibility

Describe changes to request behavior, configuration, errors, runtime support, or package exports. Write "None" when applicable.

## Related work

Link the issue and any prerequisite PR. For stacked PRs, state the merge order and intended final base branch.
